name: Mo-BRUK S.A.
summary: Mo-BRUK S.A. engages in the incineration of hazardous waste, including medical and industrial waste in Poland and internationally. The company is also involved in the stabilization and solidification of hazardous and non-hazardous inorganic waste; and production of alternative fuel from sorted municipal and industrial waste, used by cement plants, metal recycling, and waste storage. Mo-BRUK S.A. was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Korzenna, Poland.
